lines.en: Hisss, fangs bared.
Crackling earth, here I come.

lines.zh: 我在地下跟着你的脚跟。
lines.en: I follow your heels underground.
Ground trembles, here I come.
Greedy gaze on you.
Jump from the ground.
Crack, waiting for you.
Follow my steps.
Ground fissure, here I come.
My fangs travel beneath the surface.
The soil heaves along my path.
I edge toward the smell of blood.
Lurking underground.
Wait for prey.

lines.zh: 我露在地面上的只有牙尖。
lines.en: Only my tooth tips show above ground.
Deep beneath the ground.
Crack in the ground.
Hidden underground.

lines.zh: 我从土里冒出来，只夹一下。
lines.en: I rise from the soil for one snap.
Secret underground.
Secret underground.
Hidden in darkness.
Half a fang pokes above the soil.
Waiting in the gap between summonings.
My growl is muffled under the dirt.
Dark red seeps between my teeth.
I count the footsteps overhead.
Still as a stone, I do not move.

lines.zh: 我从地里冒出来，夹住你的脚。
lines.en: I rise from the ground and clamp your leg.

lines.zh: 我从地面冒出来，夹住脚踝。
lines.en: I burst from the ground and clamp your ankle.

lines.zh: 我从地缝里冒出来，夹住你的脚。
lines.en: I rise from the crack and clamp your feet.

lines.zh: 你的血滴进了我藏身的土。
lines.en: Your blood drips into the soil that hides me.

lines.zh: 我从地里冒出来，只夹一次。
lines.en: I rise from the earth and clamp once.

lines.zh: 我从地面冒出来，只夹得住一个人。
lines.en: I rise from the ground and can catch only one.

lines.zh: 地缝里的牙，只等你踏进来。
lines.en: Teeth in the crack wait for your foot.
Your presence.
A small mound swells in the ground.
Fixed on you, do not look away.
Your sole is pressing on my head.
These feet have stopped.
You hesitate at the crack.
The smell of blood rises from your ankle.
You are standing in exactly the right spot.

lines.zh: 我看见你的影子落下来
lines.en: I see your shadow fall across me.
You have not noticed what is beneath you.

lines.zh: 血牙的尖牙刺入了你的身体。
lines.en: Flesh Fang's sharp teeth pierce your flesh.

lines.zh: 你被血牙的利爪划伤了。
lines.en: Flesh Fang claws cut through your skin.
Flesh Fang's teeth bite into you.
Flesh Fang rips your clothes.

lines.zh: 血牙的毒液渗入你的伤口。
lines.en: Flesh Fang's venom seeps into your wound.

lines.zh: 血牙的尖牙撕开了你的皮肤。
lines.en: Flesh Fang's sharp teeth tear your skin.
Flesh Fang claws scratch you.
Flesh Fang's teeth clamp on you.

lines.zh: 血牙的利齿咬伤了你的手臂。
lines.en: Flesh Fang's teeth bite your arm.

lines.zh: 血牙的利爪抓伤了你的腿。
lines.en: Flesh Fang claws scratch your leg.
Hisss, showing sharp fangs.
Your scent attracted me.
Closer, feel the pain.

lines.zh: 地面下的魔法在召唤我。
lines.en: Magic under the ground calls me.
Don't panic, I'm carnivorous.
Your fear excites me.

lines.zh: 地面开始蠕动，血牙现身。
lines.en: The ground moves, Flesh Fangs appear.
Don't resist me.
My power comes from darkness.

lines.zh: 你踩上来的那一步，正好。
lines.en: That one step you took landed just right.
Hard ground stops me.

lines.zh: 从地缝里冒出来，夹住你的脚。
lines.en: I rise from the crack and clamp your foot.

lines.zh: 岩石碎片划伤了我的皮肤。
lines.en: Rock shards scratched my skin.
My teeth got stuck.
Ground obstructs my movement.
Rocks block my sight.
I tripped on your stuff.

lines.zh: 坚硬的石头让我无法前进。
lines.en: Hard stones prevent my advance.
My claws got tangled.

lines.zh: 你踩住了我刚冒出的牙。
lines.en: You step on a tooth just breaking through.

lines.zh: 我在土里等另一副牙齿。
lines.en: I wait in the soil for another set of teeth.
Two rows of teeth touch beneath the soil.

lines.zh: 我在地里扎根，等成群的牙。
lines.en: I root in the soil, waiting to grow into teeth.
My clan calls.
Mating is our duty.
My mate waits.
Mating strengthens our kind.

lines.zh: 从地面冒出的牙，正找配偶。
lines.en: Fangs from the ground, looking for a mate.

lines.zh: 我把根须缠上你的根须。
lines.en: I twine my roots around yours.
Mating is natural.

lines.zh: 它张开大口，露出锋利的獠牙。
lines.en: It opens its mouth, revealing sharp fangs.

lines.zh: 地面裂开，血牙从裂缝中钻出。
lines.en: The ground splits, and the Blood Fang emerges.

lines.zh: 血牙嘶嘶作响，逼近玩家。
lines.en: Blood Fang hisses and advances.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着嗜血的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow with a bloodthirsty light.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你将尝到痛苦的味道。
lines.en: Draw near, and you will taste pain.

lines.zh: 它用獠牙夹住猎物，鲜血四溅。
lines.en: It seizes its prey with its fangs, spraying blood.

lines.zh: 血牙在黑暗中无声地潜行。
lines.en: Blood Fang moves silently in the dark.
It feeds at night.
Do not approach it.
It is always hungry, never satisfied.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的脚踝往上提。
lines.en: I bite your ankle and lift.
The smell of blood makes me push up through the dirt.
None approach me alive.
Feel my sharp fangs!
I am a strong one in the Enmity Mob.
Your life is in my fangs.
I rise from the ground and close.
This is your time to die.

lines.zh: 土里冒出牙，围住你的脚。
lines.en: Teeth rise from the soil and ring your feet.
Your blood will feed me.
The Hateful drove me to bite him.
The target is directly above me.
Feel my magic!
I am Magic Spirit, Blood Fang.
My power cannot be stopped.

lines.zh: 我从土里冒出来，专夹脚。
lines.en: I rise from the soil to snap at feet.

lines.zh: 感受我的力量吧，你无法逃脱。
lines.en: Feel my power, you cannot escape.
You cannot escape my curse.

lines.zh: 我的力量将引导你走向死亡。
lines.en: My power will guide you to death.
I open and close, waiting for you to step down.
I will lead you to your doom.

lines.zh: 感受我的力量，你将无法逃脱。
lines.en: Feel my power, you cannot escape.
Wait for one more step.
My jaws open slowly.
I close in from the side.
Once I bite, that leg stays.
The tremor underground is the signal.
Flesh Fangs grip you!
Avoid Flesh Fangs' sharp teeth!
Watch out for Flesh Fangs!
Flesh Fangs won't let go!
Flesh Fangs' teeth bite!
Flesh Fangs attack, beware!
Flesh Fangs clamp your limbs!
Flesh Fangs' teeth rip!
Flesh Fangs won't let go!
Flesh Fangs' claws grip you!
Ground cracks, Flesh Fangs appear!
Abomination calls Flesh Fangs!
Flesh Fangs awaken from below!
Flesh Fangs emerge from the ground!
Flesh Fangs summoned by abomination!
Flesh Fangs burst from the ground!
Flesh Fangs rise from the ground!
Abomination summons Flesh Fangs to attack!
Flesh Fangs emerge from underground!
Flesh Fangs emerge from the ground!
Clods part; the fang tips show first.
The ground bulges into a mound.
I squeeze up through the fissure.
The Hateful's voice wakes me.
A dark red line splits the ground.
Blood fangs break soil, only half showing.
Flesh Fang's flames burn you.

lines.zh: 你从血牙的攻击中掉落下来。
lines.en: You fall from Flesh Fang's attack.
You are pulled underwater by Flesh Fang.
Flesh Fang's explosion shakes you.
Flesh Fang's projectile hits you.

lines.zh: 血牙的魔法咒语击中了你。
lines.en: Flesh Fang's magic spells hit you.

lines.zh: 你被血牙的饥饿控制了。
lines.en: You are controlled by Flesh Fang's hunger.
Flesh Fang's lightning strikes you.

lines.zh: 血牙将你拉入了虚无之中。
lines.en: Flesh Fang pulls you into the void.
